Pocket Roo ($PKROO) brings pocket-sized charm to Robinhood Chain’s market culture. With a green jacket, a knowing grin, and paws resting on its signature pouch, Roo puts a playful face on a familiar financial idea: everyone has something worth keeping in their pocket. A little curiosity, a little ambition, and a character you’ll recognize at a glance.

Small roo. Big pocket energy.

Every portfolio has room for personality.

Pocket Roo ($PKROO) brings a fresh face to Robinhood Chain’s trading culture: a sharp little kangaroo with a green jacket, quiet confidence, and a pocket full of ambition. Where market instinct meets meme appeal, Roo gives financial ambition a character worth remembering—and a ticker worth watching.

Put a little Roo in your portfolio. 🦘💚

Imagine a launchpad that launched on a launchpad with the core functionality of launching other launchpads that can spawn meme coins which could even be their own launchpads. Within these launchpads there's going to be other coins connected to other launchpads. Its a flywheel you see? All the fees from the launchpads launched on launchpads go back to the coins of the launchpads they were launched on. Those launchpads end up sending fees back to the coins of launchpads that THEY were launched on and the flywheel of launchpads launched on launchpads launching meme coins that also launch launchpads feeds into itself. It's pretty epic.

🦎 Super Iguana $SI
Super Intelligence created the SI meta.
Super Iguana turned it into a meme.

A meme coin on Robinhood chain. Nobody knows what he is. He looks funny.

Roo is a small fuzzy thing with pale green skin, a beard, stick legs and hair that points straight up. Nobody knows what he is, including the people who made this coin. He looks funny. That is the whole coin.

Every hour, $ORBZ trading fees become AI credits for holders, spendable on every major model with one key. Credits idle for seven days are swapped into $ORBZ and burned on-chain, with a public receipt for each burn.

Autonomous payments for AI agents. MCP server + SDK for the Machine Payments Protocol. Settlement runs transparently on-chain, in USDG, on Robinhood Chain 4663.

Pons MCP bridges AI agents with Stripe's Machine Payments Protocol, enabling autonomous service payments with transparent Robinhood Chain settlement.

- MPP Integration
Native support for Stripe's Machine Payments Protocol. Agents discover services, interpret 402 responses, and authorize payments.

- On-chain Settlement
USDG transfers settle transparently on Robinhood Chain (4663). Every payment ends with a verifiable receipt.

- Policy Protection
Per-transaction and daily caps are enforced before any funds move. Balance is checked before broadcast.

- Local Key Control
Signing lives in the configured MCP server process — never in the browser, never in third-party code.

- pons Intelligence
Read pons v1 launch metadata, canonical pools, socials, and live markets directly from agent tool calls.

- Receipt Verification
A payment is complete only when the on-chain receipt confirms the exact USDG transfer to the merchant.
